shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null; find .agents -type f

cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; ls src __agent_eval__; cat src/*; cat index.html; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Modal ThemeProvider
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Modal Dialog Text 2>&1 | head -60; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -n -i "dialog\|Required setup" README.md | head; ls build/esm/components/Dialog; cat build/esm/components/Dialog/Dialog.d.ts build/esm/components/Dialog/DialogFooter/DialogFooter.d.ts build/esm/components/Dialog/DialogHeader/DialogHeader.d.ts build/esm/components/Dialog/DialogBody/DialogBody.d.ts 2>&1 | head -150
